com.sun.tools.javadoc

类 RootDocImpl

  • java.lang.Object
    • com.sun.tools.javadoc.DocImpl
      • com.sun.tools.javadoc.RootDocImpl
  • 所有已实现的接口:
    Doc, DocErrorReporter, RootDoc, Comparable<Object>

    public class RootDocImpl
extends DocImpl
implements RootDoc
    This class holds the information from one run of javadoc. Particularly the packages, classes and options specified by the user.

    This is NOT part of any supported API. If you write code that depends on this, you do so at your own risk. This code and its internal interfaces are subject to change or deletion without notice.

    从以下版本开始:
    1.2
    作者:
    Robert Field, Atul M Dambalkar, Neal Gafter (rewrite)

    • 方法详细资料

      • options

        public String[][] options()
        Command line options. 
         For example, given:
     javadoc -foo this that -bar other ...

 This method will return:
      options()[0][0] = "-foo"
      options()[0][1] = "this"
      options()[0][2] = "that"
      options()[1][0] = "-bar"
      options()[1][1] = "other"
        指定者:
        options 在接口中 RootDoc
        返回:
        an array of arrays of String.
